question: Which of the following manifestations is LESS likely in tubulo-interstitial nephritis ?:

options.opa: Proteinuria greater than 3.5 g in 24 hours.

analysis: Tubulo-interstitial nephritis is characterized by inflammation and damage to the renal tubules and interstitium. Proteinuria greater than 3.5 g in 24 hours is a common manifestation of tubulo-interstitial nephritis due to tubular dysfunction. Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus can occur in tubulo-interstitial nephritis as a result of impaired renal tubular function. Progressive renal failure is a possible outcome of untreated or severe tubulo-interstitial nephritis. Renal tubular acidosis can also be seen in tubulo-interstitial nephritis due to tubular dysfunction.
